thread_text:
Sam: Heads up — vendor just told procurement APAC H200 lead times jumped to 14-18 weeks. We need a short play for the Q3 spike, APAC mostly. Thinking: prebook L40S buffer in edge zones + small H200 reservation for sustained throughput. Thoughts?
Jia: 14-18 weeks :grimace: what's our current on-hand weeks by SKU?
Andre: Inventory check: H100 = 6w, H200 = 2w, L40S = 10w. Effective GPU-hours/month approx H100:2.2M, H200:1.8M, L40S:1.0M (based on current cluster configs).
Sam: ok. Proposal: prebook 40 H200 units for APAC (convertible to L40S if vendor pushes) and reserve 80 L40S immediately to cover latency-sensitive inference. Keeps us across the peak without egressing too much to eu-central.
Maria: +1 on L40S prebook. Edge latency/memory profile favors L40S for chat frontends. H200 reserved for throughput-heavy batching and long-context workloads. Also confirm PD/power overhead with facilities.
Tess: Reminder on cost: H200 reservation increases committed spend (~25% bump) but reduces per-token cost by ~40% compared to on-demand L40S. We need finance signoff for the commit.
ProcureBot: Created ticket PR-4821 with vendor list and requested fast quotes (ETA 48h).
Jia: We should model routing policy 'fastpath' — route latency-sensitive requests to L40S in-region, route bulk/batch to H200 dedicated pool. Want to run three demand curves (baseline, q3-spike, worst-day).
Sam: here's a quick sim command sketch:

```
python infra/sim/forecast.py --demand q3_peak --mix '{"H200":40,"L40S":80,"H100":0}' --region apac --weeks 12
```

Andre: ran a fast sim with that mix: latency SLOs hold (p99 under 120ms for frontends), token cost +12% vs current baseline but zero outage risk. If we cut H200 to 20 units, cost delta drops to +6% but we risk throughput saturation on top 3 demand days.
Maria: also need NVLink cage planning, PD/cooling slots, and racking schedule. I'll ping facilities and confirm available power per row — APAC racks are tight in some zones.
Tess: another lever: could we swap some H200 with H100 if H100 lead times are shorter?
Andre: H100 leadtime is indeed shorter but not 1:1 replacement — our quantized inference throughput per GPU: H200 : H100 : L40S ~= 1.9 : 1.0 : 0.8. So replacing H200 with H100 requires ~1.9x more units to match throughput, changes power/cost profile.
Sam: action items: 1) ProcureBot/Procurement: validate quotes and convertible reservation terms. 2) Tess: sync with finance on pre-commit thresholds & approval path. 3) Andre: run 3 scenario sims and post numeric outputs (cost, p99, max qps). 4) Jia: draft routing policy 'fastpath' change and rollout plan for canary. 5) Maria: confirm facilities slots & power. Target: consolidate by Friday EOD.
Jia: I'll take the routing draft and run sims once Andre posts. :thumbsup:
Sam: thanks all — we'll reconvene Friday morning if numbers come in. :eyes:
